item.title: Local politicians welcome plans to turn derelict properties into council houses
item.description: Shannonside politicians are welcoming plans to turn more empty and derelict properties into social homes. The government has announced the expansion of the Buy and Renew Scheme. It will ensure more long-term vacant and derelict properties across the country will be transformed into high-quality social homes. item.title: Athlone butcher Christopher Fitzsimons jailed for 13 years - after raping girl 18 times in 13 months
item.description: By Niamh O’Donoghue and Isabel Hayes A butcher who exploited and sexually abused three of his partner’s younger sisters over a 10-year period has been jailed for 13 years. Christopher Fitzsimons (40), described in court as “a wolf in sheep's clothing”, was convicted by a Central Criminal Court jury last July of all 22 counts against him relating to the three complainants, including 18 counts of raping one of the girls over an 13-month period. item.title: Flood damaged worsened by underinvestment - TD Sorca Clarke
item.description: A local TD has said the government cannot stop storms but must prevent predictable flood damage. item.title: Poacher praises McNulty as Leitrim down London
item.description: Leitrim boss Steven Poacher poured praise on Barry McNulty as his side got their promotion hunt back on track. Leitrim trailed London by 10 points at half-time. However, McNulty kicked 12 points, including five two-pointers as Leitrim came back to win by two points. “I don’t think people outside Leitrim really understand or appreciate the contribution he makes to Leitrim, both on and off the field” explained Leitirm boss Poacher.
